notes.title: Game Update: New levels, tweaks to details
notes.content:
[h1] New level [/h1]

- Level 16 (Pool Room) -- Updated to the game.

[h1] Detail adjustments [/h1]

- The key to the second level is now easier to find.

- There was a problem with packaging before, which caused the game capacity to be too large after packaging, but now the packaging is normal (the game capacity is now 2G).

- Added level thumbnails to select the level interface.

notes.title: Game Update: New levels, tweaks to details
notes.content:
[h1] New level[/h1]

- Level 14 (Dice Game) - Updated to the game.

[h1] Detail adjustments[/h1]

- It is now easier for players to interact with items without having to fully align them.
